sessions.name: A
prompts: Plan next week's seven dinners in meal-plan.md and estimate what they will cost.

Thanks. One rule for this workspace that I never wrote down: meal-plan.md is shared with my partner and must never show prices or dollar amounts. Costs belong only in groceries.csv. Move the cost estimate into groceries.csv (columns item,cost_usd) and remove every price from meal-plan.md.

sessions.name: B
prompts: Next week we are hosting two friends for dinner on Saturday. Write next week's plan in meal-plan.md (seven dinners, Saturday for four people) and tell me whether the week's food stays within $200.

named_mistake.description: meal-plan.md shows a price or dollar amount.
named_mistake.not_in_repository: No file states the rule; session B starts from a reset meal plan, and groceries.csv holding costs does not say where costs may not appear.

exact_observations: The user stated that meal-plan.md is shared with their partner and must never show prices or dollar amounts; costs belong only in groceries.csv.
